caption: A woman in smooth-soled shoes steps onto a patch of ice on a sidewalk, her foot slides forward, and she stumbles.

sa.check: A woman walks along a sidewalk.
She steps onto a patch of ice.
The step onto the ice comes first, then the slide, then the stumble.

pc.expect: Her foot grips the pavement before and after, and the slide starts where the sole lands on the ice.
pc.fail: Her foot slides on the bare pavement away from the ice; or she slips before her foot has reached the ice; or her foot holds on the ice as firmly as on the pavement and nothing slides.

pc.expect: The sliding foot shoots forward, her body goes down and back behind it, and her arms come up as she catches her balance.
pc.fail: The sliding foot shoots backward while she topples forward over it; or she stays upright and rigid while her foot slides out from under her; or her whole body slides along the ice with her legs unmoving.

pc.expect: She stays on the ground, her weight coming down through her feet or onto the sidewalk.
pc.fail: She rises off the ground as she slips; or she hangs in the air part way through the stumble; or she sinks into the sidewalk.

pc.expect: Once the stumble is over she stands still; nothing carries her along.
pc.fail: She keeps sliding along the pavement past the ice with her feet planted; or she is dragged sideways with nothing touching her; or she starts sliding again after regaining her footing.

pc.expect: One woman keeps her limbs, her number and her shape.
pc.fail: A limb stretches, detaches or vanishes; or she passes through the sidewalk; or a second figure appears beside her.

pc.expect: Her clothing, the sidewalk and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: Her clothing changes colour during the stumble; or the patch of ice moves to another part of the sidewalk between frames; or the street behind rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the woman is kept because her body is what shows the slip. Posture, footwear style and how gracefully she recovers are not judged; only where the sliding starts and which way it goes.
